title: Bitfinex Proudly Celebrates 11 Years of Innovation and Leadership in Bitcoin
notes: First-party retrospective stating Bitfinex was born on 6 November 2012 and initially launched as a P2P margin-lending platform for Bitcoin; it also states Lending Pro launched in July 2020 as an automation tool for the margin-funding market.

title: Margin Funding on Bitfinex
notes: Current first-party support describing the P2P funding platform, funding wallet, provider-selected amount/rate/term, matching and interest tracking.

title: Margin Funding interest on Bitfinex
notes: Current first-party support documenting provider interest calculation and the funding-provider fee deduction.

title: Risks associated with offering funding — Frequently Asked Questions
notes: Current first-party risk guidance stating Margin Funding is not risk-free and that extreme market moves could ultimately cause losses to be shared with funding providers despite collateral and liquidation controls.

title: Announcement on Launch of Poloniex Earn
notes: First-party launch announcement stating Poloniex Earn rollout began on 28 December 2022 and the first Polo Earn subscriptions would open on 4 January 2023 at 00:00 UTC.

title: Announcement on USDD Soft Staking Reward Adjustments (January 3)
notes: First-party confirmation that official Polo Earn subscriptions would open on 4 January 2023 at 00:00 UTC; the notice also carries a high-market-risk warning and disclaims liability for investment losses.

title: An Introduction to Poloniex Earn
notes: First-party product guide describing flexible/fixed terms, daily interest, auto-subscription and redemption mechanics and characterising all Poloniex Earn investment products as principal-protected.

title: Limited-Time Offer: Subscribe to USAT Flexible and Earn 10% APY
notes: First-party March 2026 launch of a USAT Flexible product confirming continuing Poloniex Earn operation and current flexible redemption/interest mechanics.
